File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Add a `.catch(() => setBusy(false))` or use `try/finally` around `exportReport` in `handleClick` so that `setBusy(false)` runs even when the export promise rejects, preventing the export button from remaining stuck in a busy state.

args.body:
label: bug
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

In `src/components/ExportButton.tsx`, `handleClick` calls `exportReport(reportId, format).then(...)` without a `.catch()` handler, leaving `busy` set to `true` when `exportReport` throws on a failed export response. We need to add a `.catch(() => setBusy(false))` or use `try/finally` around `exportReport` in `handleClick` so that `setBusy(false)` runs even when the export promise rejects.
